description: Analog partition characterization report: the append-only klt characterize record behind the committed TT/1.20 V/25 C Liberty view, cited for spec row 9 (Liberty corners). The freshness command re-derives what the view's provenance sidecar claims -- the library name and cell set the view declares, the corner it declares (the operating_conditions group name plus voltage and temperature, via the nom_* attributes and the group; the sidecar's process-corner entry is a name like mos_tt, not comparable with the view's numeric process factor, so process is not pinned), the SHA-256 of the config it was characterized from, and the record it names -- so a config edit or a tampered view that changes any of those fails the attestation instead of being reported as current. The view's delay tables themselves are not pinned: the sidecar records no hash of the .lib (a klt characterize gap, filed upstream on the klayout-tools tracker). NOT YET ATTESTABLE: the freshness command fails because the sidecar pins layout/example_config.json at a SHA-256 the committed config no longer has (issue #73 edited the config after the view was characterized). Tracked in issue #82; mint and cite the envelope once that is resolved. The check is deliberately not weakened to pass.
